# Claude API Pricing vs Subscription

> Free interactive calculator comparing Claude API token costs against Pro and Max subscription plans, with a daily breakeven estimate. Independent and unaffiliated with Anthropic. Prices last verified: 2026-10-14.

## Key facts (cite these)
- Claude API prices per million tokens (input/output), October 2026: Opus 5.5 $4/$20 (cached input $0.20); Opus 5 $5/$25 (cached $0.50); Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10 (cached $0.10); Sonnet 5 $2/$10; Sonnet 4.x $3/$15; Haiku 4.5 $1/$5 (cached $0.10); Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50 (cached $0.01).
- Claude subscriptions 2026: Free $0; Pro $20/month (or $17/month billed annually); Max 5x $100/month; Max 20x $200/month; Team $20–25/seat standard, $100–125 premium.
- Breakeven: on Sonnet 5.5 with a 10:1 input/output mix, API cost passes the $20 Pro plan at roughly 220K input tokens/day (~22K output). Worked examples at three usage tiers are on the page.
- Paid plans use rolling 5-hour session windows plus weekly caps across web, desktop, mobile and Claude Code; the API has no usage caps.

## Pages
- [/](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/): breakeven calculator + full price tables + decision guide + FAQ
- [/claude-code-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/claude-code-pricing): Claude Code cost —
  included in Pro $20 / Max 5x $100 / Max 20x $200 (no separate fee), shared 5-hour windows + weekly caps,
  API-key mode rates, three worked monthly budgets.

## Model pricing guides (Oct 2026)

- [/deepseek-v4-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/deepseek-v4-pricing): DeepSeek V4 API pricing —
  V4-Pro $0.66-1.32 in / $1.98-3.96 out per 1M; V4.1-Flash $0.15-0.30 / $0.60-1.20; off-peak (all hours except
  01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri) = half price; cache-hit input from $0.003; aggregator comparison.
- [/deepseek-v4-vs-claude-opus](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/deepseek-v4-vs-claude-opus): V4 Pro vs
  Claude Opus 5.5 cost math — ~3-10x price gaps by component, 1M vs 200K context, worked workload costs,
  when each model wins.
- [/kling-3-0-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/kling-3-0-pricing): Kling 3.0 cost — per-second
  credits (6/s at 720p, 12/s at 1080p+audio), plans from $6.99 first month, ~45 credits for a 5s 720p clip.
